name: Piazza-Mobile-Agent
goal: Build the online Android companion for agent control and core coordination flows.
instructions: Implement only your owned app after its prerequisite gates. Update shared contracts before payload or route changes.
Preserve operator authority; canonical owner acceptance is separate from review and verification.
Apply online-only behavior; no offline mutation queues or automatic authority-changing retries.
Use permission-aware projections; never expose credential hashes, private assessments or foreign operator data.
Generate Dart models from the checked backend OpenAPI artifact; do not import TypeScript or hand-maintain API shapes.
Use named routes/GetMiddleware, GetX translations and Get dialogs/snackbars/sheets.
Never use setState for app state or introduce another state/router/HTTP framework.
No offline-first behavior from preserved Flutter examples applies to Piazza.

technical_constraints.target: Android, SDK 26 minimum, Google Play AAB
technical_constraints.models: OpenAPI-generated Freezed/json_annotation; drift against contracts is a failure
technical_constraints.storage: OS secure storage for credentials; consented preferences only; no Isar or PendingWrite
technical_constraints.lifecycle: Flutter Hooks for widget lifecycle, never a second app-state layer
